title: Hackers Remotely Kill a Jeep on a Highway | WIRED
summary: WIRED's Andy Greenberg drives a Jeep on a highway while two hackers take control of it remotely over the internet. They manipulate the car and then cut the engine. The video accompanies the 2015 article on the Jeep Cherokee hack.
why: HN cites it as the standard precedent for remote car hacking whenever connected or self-driving vehicle security comes up.
